decision: Replace the Google Maps feature point with the centroid of the project-site polygon that the Servicio de Evaluación Ambiental publishes for 'Data Center Cirion' (ICE of 12 January 2024, Table 4.1.1), transformed from UTM zone 19S (WGS84, EPSG:32719) to WGS84 longitude/latitude.
source_table: Tabla N°4.1.1 Coordenadas de ubicación de lugar de emplazamiento del Proyecto (datum WGS84, huso 19S), page 17 (pdftotext -layout)
area_note: The four printed vertices are rounded to whole metres and describe a simplified quadrilateral; its area is 7 percent below the stated net site area, so it is treated as an outline of the plot, not a surveyed boundary.
transform: pyproj 3.7.1 Transformer EPSG:32719 -> EPSG:4326 (always_xy); shapely 2.1.1 polygon centroid
identity_bridge: The ICE names proponent Cirion Technologies Chile S.A. and the site Víctor Uribe Sur #2290, Loteo Industrial Aconcagua, Quilicura; Cirion's SAN2 specification sheet gives the same address for SAN2, and Cirion's SAN2 page says SAN2 is in Quilicura and covers 23,000 m2.
nearby_records_within_2km: Only this site (curated:cirion-san2-quilicura-data-center, 76 m from the new point) in verified_construction_core/2026-11-07-research-hundredtwentieth; no pending queue addition or locator correction within 2 km.
